headlines.title: Cuba acusa EEUU de imponerse a fuerza
Los detalles de la nueva ruta de transporte de mercancías entre España y Cuba
Smoking in Cuba and Our New Poverty
WHO chief visits Cuba amid severe shortages at hospitals and worsening health conditions
Cuba acusa a EEUU de pretender la «imposición de la paz» mediante «la fuerza»

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Cuba acusa a EEUU de pretender la «imposición de la paz» mediante «la fuerza». [5]
The WHO chief visits Cuba amid severe shortages at hospitals and worsening health conditions. [4]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR CUBA
The WHO chief's visit highlights severe hospital shortages, which is consistent with the most severe government travel advisory World Monitor tracks for Cuba being Reconsider Travel, as of Nov 24, 2026. [4][E2]

KEY RISKS
Cuba is linked to 127 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Nov 24, 2026. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market related to Cuba, "US strike on Cuba by December 31?", priced Yes at 7% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E5]
A Polymarket market related to Cuba, "Miguel Díaz-Canel out as leader of Cuba by December 31?", priced Yes at 8% on Nov 24, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2027. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the WHO chief's visit will lead to improvements in hospital shortages and health conditions. [4]
